# TestScript for 05-domain-types
# Asserts File (with capability tags), Dir, ByteSize, and custom SelfValidator types

# 1. Defaults
exec domain-demo
stdout '⚙  domain-demo'
stdout '-m, --max-memory\s+conga\.ByteSize\s+512MiB\s+· default'
stdout '-l, --deploy-hook\s+conga\.File\s+—\s+○ unset'
stdout '--payload\s+conga\.FileContent\s+—\s+○ unset'
stdout '--output\s+conga\.File\s+—\s+○ unset'
stdout 'Validated Domain Types: max_memory_bytes=536870912'

# 2. Valid domain types with created files/dirs/symlinks
mkdir output_folder
symlink deploy-hook -> hook.sh
exec domain-demo -i valid.txt -o output_folder -m 2GiB -l deploy-hook -p 8000-8080 -H Accept=application/json -H Content-Type=text/html
stdout '-i, --input-file\s+conga\.File\s+valid\.txt\s+● cli --input-file'
stdout '-o, --output-dir\s+conga\.Dir\s+output_folder\s+● cli --output-dir'
stdout '-m, --max-memory\s+conga\.ByteSize\s+2GiB\s+● cli --max-memory'
stdout '-l, --deploy-hook\s+conga\.File\s+deploy-hook\s+● cli --deploy-hook'
stdout '-p, --ports\s+main\.PortRange\s+8000-8080\s+● cli --ports'
stdout '-H, --headers\s+main\.HeaderMap\s+Accept=application/json, Content-Type=text/html\s+● cli --headers'
stdout 'Validated Domain Types: max_memory_bytes=2147483648'

# 3. Non-existent file fails existing validation
exit-status 2 domain-demo -i nonexistent.txt
stderr 'stat nonexistent\.txt: no such file or directory for flag --input-file'

# 4. Directory passed to existing file validation fails
exit-status 2 domain-demo -i output_folder
stderr '"output_folder" is a directory, but a file was expected for flag --input-file'

# 5. File passed to existing dir validation fails
exit-status 2 domain-demo -o valid.txt
stderr '"valid\.txt" is a file, but a directory was expected for flag --output-dir'

# 6. Invalid port range (min > max) fails custom SelfValidator.Validate()
exit-status 2 domain-demo -p 9000-8000
stderr 'invalid port range 9000-8000 \(must be 1\.\.65535 and min <= max\) for flag --ports'

# 7. Malformed byte size unit fails coercion
exit-status 2 domain-demo -m 5XB
stderr 'unknown byte size unit "XB" in "5XB" for flag --max-memory'

# 8. Invalid header name fails custom SelfValidator.Validate() on map domain type
exit-status 2 domain-demo -H X-Bad@Header=value
stderr 'invalid header: header name "X-Bad@Header" contains invalid characters for flag --headers'

# 9. Restricted header fails custom SelfValidator.Validate() on map domain type
exit-status 2 domain-demo -H Authorization=secret
stderr 'invalid header: header "Authorization" cannot be passed via command line for flag --headers'

# 10. Domain types earn file completion for free (File with existing tag)
exec domain-demo __complete export -i ''
stdout '\"value\":\"valid\.txt\"'

# 11. Domain types earn directory completion for free (Dir with existing tag)
exec domain-demo __complete export -o ''
stdout '\"value\":\"output_folder/\"'

# 12. Domain types earn symlink completion for free (Symlink)
exec domain-demo __complete export -l ''
stdout '\"value\":\"deploy-hook\"'
! stdout '\"value\":\"valid\.txt\"'

# 13. FileContent loads a payload file into memory at decode time
exec domain-demo -i valid.txt --payload payload.txt
stdout '--payload\s+conga\.FileContent\s+payload-data'
stdout 'payload_bytes=[0-9]+'

# 14. FileContent reads '-' from the engine-configured stdin
stdin streamed.txt
exec domain-demo -i valid.txt --payload -
stdout 'payload_bytes=[0-9]+'

# 15. File.IsStdio detects the '-' sink and keeps the payload stream clean
exec domain-demo -i valid.txt --payload payload.txt --output -
stdout 'payload-data'
stderr 'output stream detected; diagnostics stay on stderr'

# 16. A File with stdin:"true" streams lazily via Reader() from the engine stdin
stdin streamed.txt
exec domain-demo -q -
stdout '-q, --query\s+conga\.File\s+-\s+● cli --query'
stdout 'query_bytes=[0-9]+'

# 17. The same stdin-capable flag accepts a regular file path
exec domain-demo -q valid.txt
stdout '-q, --query\s+conga\.File\s+valid\.txt\s+● cli --query'
stdout 'query_bytes=[0-9]+'

# 18. glob:"*.yaml,*.yml" filters file completion candidates by name pattern
exec domain-demo __complete export --templates ''
stdout '"value":"template\.yaml"'
stdout '"value":"settings\.yml"'
! stdout 'notes\.txt'

-- payload.txt --
payload-data

-- valid.txt --
key=value

-- hook.sh --
#!/bin/sh
echo "deployment hook executed"

-- template.yaml --
kind: Deployment

-- settings.yml --
theme: dark

-- notes.txt --
plain notes

-- streamed.txt --
streamed-payload
